name: Flohmarkt am Mauerpark
facts: about 100 reservable private stalls plus open-air pitches and commercial traders
private sellers get priority over commercial ones
notes: Organiser site is stale (last blog post Dec 2022, prices "until 30.09.2024"). Marktordnung table says Sunday 09:00–18:00, blog posts say 10–18; recorded 10:00. Nov 15 and Nov 22 (Volkstrauertag, Totensonntag) dropped because the organiser cancelled those Sundays in 2022 for the same holidays; not confirmed for 2026. Entry fee not stated on organiser pages. Address postcode 13355 from the organiser Kontakt page (README example says 10435). Site only reachable over plain http.

description.de: Jeden Sonntag an der Bernauer Straße, direkt am Mauerpark. Rund 100 reservierbare Privatstände, dazu freie Plätze und gewerbliche Händler; private Verkäufer haben Vorrang, Gebrauchtes geht vor Neuware. Überdachte Mietstände gibt es vor Ort.
description.en: Every Sunday on Bernauer Straße, right beside Mauerpark. About 100 reservable private stalls plus open pitches and commercial traders; private sellers get priority and second-hand comes before new goods. Covered rental stalls are available on site.
